_about: Acetonitrile (1) + MTBE (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 95.5 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Prasad, T. E. V.[T. E. Vittal], Kumar, R. K., Prasad, D. H. L., (Vapor + liquid) equilibrium of the binary mixtures formed by acetonitrile with selected compounds at 95.5 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 39 (2007) 1458-1462
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 26. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.38 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
